study type: retrospective, nested case-control study with cohort sensitivity analysis
exposure: maternal bivalent RSV prefusion F (RSVpreF) vaccine
outcome: RSV-related lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) hospital admissions in infants aged 90 days or younger
cohort: The participants were all singleton livebirths in Scotland between August 12, 2024, and March 31, 2025, with cases being infants aged 90 days or younger experiencing RSV-related LRTI hospital admissions, matched to controls without such admissions.
finding: Maternal RSV vaccination significantly reduced the risk of RSV-related lower respiratory tract infection (LRTI) hospital admission by 82.2% in infants aged 90 days or younger, including preterm infants.
birth_weight: N/A (birthweight was adjusted for in the analysis, but specific weights of babies included are not detailed)
gest_age: Includes preterm (<37 weeks' gestation) and term (>=37 weeks' gestation) infants
